description_en: Updates the information of a route target group instance, including the name, description, and disabled members
description_zh: 更新路由目标组实例信息，包括名称、描述、未使能的成员
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-route-target-group --route-target-group-id rtg-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRouteTargetGroup

parameters.help_en: The routing target group instance ID
parameters.name: route_target_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the route target group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: route_target_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the route target group. 

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的描述信息。 

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: route_target_group_description

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the route target group member
fields.name: member_id

fields.help_en:
The member type of the route target group.

Currently supported type:

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

In active/standby mode, all members of the route target group must be of the same type
fields.help_zh:
路由目标组的成员类型。

当前支持的类型：

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

主备模式下，路由目标组所有成员的类型必须相同
fields.name: member_type

fields.help_en:
The weight of the route target group member. Valid values:

100: The member is the active instance.
0: The member is the standby instance.

The weight can only be set during creation and cannot be modified
fields.help_zh:
路由目标组成员的权重值。取值：

100：表示成员为主实例。
0：表示成员为备实例。

权重值仅支持在创建时设置，不支持修改
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The member list of the route target group.

In active/standby mode, the following limits apply to route target group members:

The number of route target group members must be 2.
The route target group members must belong to different zones
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的成员列表。

主备模式下，对路由目标组成员有如下限制：

路由目标组成员数量必须为2
路由目标组成员必须属于不同可用区
parameters.name: route_target_member_list

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the route target group instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 路由目标组实例所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
